reasons: The claimed deviation is supported: p0188 binds only Customer, requires IBM consent, lacks an affiliate and substantially-all-assets carve-out, and imposes no restriction on IBM's own assignment (including to a Customer competitor).

The redline reaches the preferred position with a targeted rewrite of the first two sentences: mutual consent not unreasonably withheld, bar on IBM assigning to a Customer competitor, Customer carve-out for Affiliate/successor by merger, consolidation, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, and express confirmation that Customer change of control gives IBM no termination/suspension/re-pricing right; the existing void-assignment and continuing-liability sentences are preserved.
Changed-character ratio (0.54) is justified because making an asymmetric restriction mutual and inserting the carve-outs necessarily rewrites the operative sentences; no unrelated terms were altered.
Comment is accurate, correctly states what changed and why, cites the playbook position and offers the mutual notice fallback; tone and prefix conform.

Minor drafting note (not disqualifying): 'Affiliate' is capitalized but does not appear in the resolved definitions for this Agreement — consider lower-casing or adding a definition so the carve-out is not ambiguous.
